description: This file contains the implementation of a Validator class used for schema validation in AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to validate complex data structures according to specified constraints and schema types.
external_files: Aws" (used for describe_type and possibly other helpers within the AWS SDK namespace)

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating data against a schema with various constraints, supporting nested structures and multiple data types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Validator object with optional custom constraints.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates input data against a given shape/schema and throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches validation to the appropriate check method based on shape type.

methods.name: check_structure
methods.description: Validates a structure shape, including required properties and nested members.

methods.name: check_list
methods.description: Validates a list shape, including element types and counts.

methods.name: check_map
methods.description: Validates a map shape, including key/value types.

methods.name: check_blob
methods.description: Validates a blob type, ensuring it can be cast or used as a resource.

methods.name: check_numeric
methods.description: Validates numeric types, including range constraints.

methods.name: check_boolean
methods.description: Validates boolean types.

methods.name: check_string
methods.description: Validates string types, including pattern matching and length constraints.

methods.name: validateRange
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within specified min and max range constraints.

methods.name: checkArray
methods.description: Checks if an array is either an indexed or associative array.

methods.name: isAssociative
methods.description: Determines if an array is associative.

methods.name: isIndexed
methods.description: Checks if an array is an indexed array.

methods.name: checkCanString
methods.description: Checks if a value can be cast to a string.

methods.name: checkAssociativeArray
methods.description: Validates that a value is an associative array.

methods.name: checkDocumentType
methods.description: Validates if a value conforms to document type expectations.

methods.name: checkUnion
methods.description: Validates union types, ensuring only one non-null value.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error message to the errors list, with path context.

methods.name: canJsonEncode
methods.description: Checks if a variable can be JSON encoded.
